title: Minimax Linear Off-Policy Estimation under Product-Bernoulli Assignment with Heterogeneous Overlap
banked_reason: Unrestricted all-Borel risk remains separated from F by rank or fiber factors that may grow exponentially; no non-identical bounded same-topic repair reaches the field floor.
gap_reasons: Unrestricted all-Borel risk remains separated from F by rank or fiber factors that may grow exponentially.
The exact all-Borel equality is proved only on the additive one-hub l1 family; the envelope separation is not a generic sharpness failure on the published class.
The dimension-free universal comparison, unconditional reverse consistency, and compressed bounded-treewidth exact algorithm remain open.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the exact assignment-indexed linear minimax program and covariance-moment dual, an instance-adaptive rank/fiber comparison, exact additive one-hub all-Borel equality, and sharp additive-hub envelope separation. Distinct universal-prior routes failed for complementary reasons: atom labels are revealed, ellipsoid priors lose a rank factor, fiber priors lose effective assignment count, and local/product priors miss global correlations. After a final whole-core repair and clean mathematical/citation review, the cold panel still rated the result subfield because the universal comparison and compressed treewidth algorithm remain unresolved.
tldr: For the fixed causal target \(\theta\) under one known product-Bernoulli source assignment, the exact assignment-indexed linear minimax risk satisfies \(F=\mathcal D\), is attained, and is computable by an explicit vertex epigraph with \(n2^n+1\) variables and \(\prod_i|\operatorname{vert}(K_i)|\) constraints. Genuine-prior and primal certificates give \(\max\{F/r_{\star},m_{\mathrm{fib}}\}\le R^{\star}\le F\le S_{\mathrm{fib}}\), while the clipped incidence rule attains risk at most \(F\). Additive hubs have the exact one-hub all-Borel equality and the broader \(n^{-1}\) frontier; on that explicit family the Loomba--Eckles envelope is separated by \(\Theta_{\varepsilon}(n+n^2(q_n-p_n)^2)\), with elbow \(|q_n-p_n|\asymp n^{-1/2}\). This is not a generic observable-law sharpness claim. Dimension-free linear-versus-all-Borel comparison and exact compressed bounded-treewidth computation remain open.
gap: LoombaEckles2026OffPolicy identifies the unique minimum-norm unbiased Fourier transport weight and a degree-based sufficient consistency bound, but it does not benchmark against biased linear rules or all measurable estimators. ChenValiantValiant2020 formulates the generic semilinear problem, exhibits a strict nonlinear improvement, and explicitly leaves the size of that gap open.
fill: The project derives the exact selector and moment dual, constructs the clipped incidence rule and certified lower and upper bounds, and concentrates the novel work in a dimension-free posterior-ambiguity rounding theorem. It then converts that comparison into an iff consistency boundary and demonstrates strict value over degree counting on an explicit overlapping family.
